name: pdk-dbt-claude-dbt
instr:
We switched most of the Claude connector's tables to Fivetran history mode last week, and the Claude reports have been wrong since: costs and tokens are inflated, people show up more than once, and API key counts are off. The package is in /app and we build it through the integration project in /app/integration_tests. A sample of the latest sync is in /data/claude_sync/, one CSV per table, named like the project's seeds.

claude__platform_cost_usage_report, claude__enterprise_cost_usage_report, claude__user_summary and claude__code_report should come out the way a normal sync of the current data would give them: every cost, usage, activity and Claude Code record counted once at its latest figures, and records Anthropic has since withdrawn not counted at all. Names, roles, key statuses and workspace memberships should be the current ones. Deleted users and API keys should still show their last known details, marked as deleted, and deleted workspaces should keep their names.

One change on top of that: message usage that doesn't name a workspace should be charged to the workspace its API key was in on that day, or to the key's first recorded workspace for usage older than the key's history.

Any table can be in history mode or synced normally, and we'll move more over later. dbt seed and dbt build should still pass on the project's own seeds with the existing data tests. The project stays SQL: only SQL models, macros and YAML, with no Python models. There's no network here; dbt
